age_calculation.name: Age Calculation
age_calculation.description: Calculates the subject's age at the time of the baseline visit.

body_mass_index.name: Body Mass Index (BMI)
body_mass_index.description: A measure of body fat based on height and weight. Assumes height is in meters and weight is in kilograms.

waist_to_hip_ratio.name: Waist-to-Hip Ratio (WHR)
waist_to_hip_ratio.description: A measure of body fat distribution, used as an indicator of health risk.

body_surface_area_dubois.name: Body Surface Area (BSA) - Du Bois Formula
body_surface_area_dubois.description: Calculates the total surface area of the human body. Used for indexing cardiac parameters. Assumes height in cm and weight in kg.

mean_arterial_pressure.name: Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP)
mean_arterial_pressure.description: The average arterial pressure throughout one cardiac cycle.
mean_arterial_pressure.expression: MAP = Diastolic blood pressure + (1/3 * (Systolic blood pressure - Diastolic blood pressure))

pulse_pressure.name: Pulse Pressure (PP)
pulse_pressure.description: The difference between systolic and diastolic blood pressure.
pulse_pressure.expression: PP = Systolic blood pressure - Diastolic blood pressure

homa_ir.name: Homeostatic Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance (HOMA-IR)
homa_ir.description: A method used to quantify insulin resistance and beta-cell function. The constant (22.5) assumes insulin in mU/L and glucose in mmol/L.

de_ritis_ratio.name: De Ritis Ratio (AST/ALT Ratio)
de_ritis_ratio.description: The ratio of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) to alanine aminotransferase (ALT). It can be used to help determine the cause of liver damage.

non_hdl_cholesterol.name: Non-HDL Cholesterol
non_hdl_cholesterol.description: Calculates the total cholesterol minus high-density lipoprotein cholesterol, representing all atherogenic lipoprotein particles.

triglyceride_hdl_ratio.name: Triglyceride to HDL Ratio
triglyceride_hdl_ratio.description: A strong predictor of insulin resistance and cardiovascular disease risk.

ckd_epi_egfr.name: eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021 Formula)
ckd_epi_egfr.description: The standard formula for estimating Glomerular Filtration Rate from serum creatinine, age, and sex. The provided 'GFR' variable is likely calculated using this method.
ckd_epi_egfr.expression: Complex formula involving constants based on sex and creatinine level. e.g., For female with Cr <= 0.7: 142 * (Cr/0.7)^-0.241 * 0.9938^Age * 1.012

fib_4_index.name: FIB-4 Index for Liver Fibrosis
fib_4_index.description: A non-invasive score to estimate liver fibrosis in patients with liver disease. Requires age to be calculated first.

stroke_volume_simpson.name: Stroke Volume (SV) by Simpson's Method
stroke_volume_simpson.description: The volume of blood pumped from the left ventricle per beat, calculated from end-diastolic and end-systolic volumes.

ejection_fraction_simpson.name: Ejection Fraction (EF) by Simpson's Method
ejection_fraction_simpson.description: The percentage of blood leaving the left ventricle with each contraction. This is the direct formula for the 'EFsimpson' variable.

cardiac_output_simpson.name: Cardiac Output (CO) by Simpson's Method
cardiac_output_simpson.description: The volume of blood pumped by the heart per minute. This is the direct formula for the 'COsimpson' variable.

e_e_prime_ratio.name: E/e' Ratio (Average)
e_e_prime_ratio.description: A key echocardiographic measure used to estimate left ventricular filling pressures and assess diastolic dysfunction.

relative_wall_thickness.name: Relative Wall Thickness (RWT)
relative_wall_thickness.description: An echocardiographic measurement used to classify the pattern of left ventricular hypertrophy.

left_ventricular_mass_devereux.name: Left Ventricular Mass (LVM) - Devereux Formula
left_ventricular_mass_devereux.description: An estimation of the weight of the left ventricle muscle, used to assess for hypertrophy.

body_fat_percentage.name: Body Fat Percentage
body_fat_percentage.description: The percentage of total body mass that is composed of fat.

cha2ds2_vasc_score.name: CHA2DS2-VASc Score
cha2ds2_vasc_score.description: A clinical prediction rule for estimating the risk of stroke in patients with non-rheumatic atrial fibrillation (AF). Note: Requires clinical history of CHF, Stroke, and Vascular Disease which are not explicitly provided but may be inferred.
cha2ds2_vasc_score.expression: Scoring System: C(CHF)=1, H(Hypertension)=1, A2(Age>=75)=2, D(Diabetes)=1, S2(Stroke/TIA)=2, V(Vascular Disease)=1, A(Age 65-74)=1, Sc(Sex category, Female)=1.

has_bled_score.name: HAS-BLED Score
has_bled_score.description: A clinical prediction rule for estimating the 1-year risk of major bleeding in patients on anticoagulation for atrial fibrillation (AF). Note: Requires history of bleeding and labile INRs which are not provided.
has_bled_score.expression: Scoring System: H(Hypertension)=1, A(Abnormal Renal/Liver function)=1 each, S(Stroke)=1, B(Bleeding history)=1, L(Labile INR)=1, E(Elderly, Age>65)=1, D(Drugs/Alcohol)=1 each.

ascvd_pce_score.name: ASCVD Pooled Cohort Equations (PCE) Risk Score
ascvd_pce_score.description: Estimates the 10-year risk of a first atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) event. Requires age, sex, race, cholesterol levels, blood pressure, and status of diabetes, smoking, and hypertension treatment.
ascvd_pce_score.expression: Complex logarithmic equation based on risk factors. Example for white male: 1 - 0.9144^exp((12.344 * log(Age) + ... - 61.18))
